method.screen: Fixed balanced factorial screen:24 synthetic profiles x5 scenes x4 trials,480 clusters/3840 outcomes; all matched and unequal-quality cells retained. Screen intervals are descriptive; no pooled binomial assumption across heterogeneous fixed profiles.
method.confirmationSelection: Choose favored matched scene with greatest full-minus-control point estimate among hot/cold favored; adverse matched scene with smallest estimate among hot/cold adverse. Ties lexical. Pool both root contexts for selection, retain all screen cells.
method.confirmation: For each selected scene,128 fresh cases per fixed original orientation,256 per scene/512 total. Draw one of8 matched-quality template/root profiles independently and uniformly WITH replacement for each case, using a profile-domain SHA256; independent gameplay seed namespace. Exact side balance, template/root counts random and reported. Target is the equal-orientation uniform profile-mixture expectation, unconditional on profile draws. No rejection sampling or winner-based resampling.
method.inference: Two selected scenes x2 contrasts (111-000 and111-110) x2 fixed orientation strata x2 discordance probabilities x2 tails =32 simultaneous one-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds at alpha=.05/32. Subtract direction-probability bounds within orientation and average orientations; family-wise95% coverage for four confirmation differences under iid mixture sampling within orientation. Confirm arm000,110,111 on identical fresh inputs. Screen and confirmation remain separate.
method.primary: Fresh confirmation of full stack versus control at the selected matched favored/adverse corners; incremental halftime contrast co-primary in the same interval family. Raw win rates and all remaining screen/interaction/quality cells descriptive.

confidence.candidateStatus: tested reduced-020; 6400-seed confirmation confidence +1.89 points and shared stack +1.91; provisional, broader validation and adoption pending

combinedPsychological.note: Measure confidence, crowd support and frustration together; no duplicate motivation bonuses.

weather.note: Shared physical conditions; relative advantage emerges from roster/tactics/rotation, not a team-strength scalar.

personalMechanisms.note: Halftime decisions and heat/cold traits must be measured, not assumed small; useful tactical changes may have large conditional effects.

criteriaStatus: Existing provisional review references, not newly adopted pass margins or winner clamps. Raw60/65% references apply to matched rosters, not already strong baseline favorites.
